performer.name: The Brain
performer.stance: the body's press secretary: smooth, pompous, slowly realising he only announces what was already decided

structure: press briefing: statement, department reports, security briefing, historical corrections, leaked memo, questions
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck that describes the human body as a city. A performer gives a press briefing about the city's departments, crises and history.
bestOfReason: Opening 1-2: the city exists and the citizen was never asked - sets up who is not in charge.
Department reports 5, 7, 9, 10, 28: each organ runs without the spokesman; Lungs is his one manual override, Night Shift closes the working day.
Security briefing 11, 15, 18, 17, 19: memory, copying errors, the competitor, friendly fire - the spokesman loses his spin.
Off the record 26: the brain fills gaps with guesses - the craft of a spokesman exposed.
Historical corrections 21, 23, 24, 30: looking beats the book; the institution rejects the finding; the Humoralist as the first kayfabe.
Leaked memo 6: the performer reads his own card - press secretary, not president (the turn).
Landing 32: the body is the score.

omitted.3: machine-vs-body thesis already carried by 1 and 2
omitted.8: fun but a second filtering joke after Liver; numbers crowd the line
omitted.12: slow broadcast idea overlaps the briefing frame itself
omitted.13: energy motor breaks the department rhythm
omitted.16: abstract; weak in a spoken line
omitted.22: Harvey's math point dilutes the Semmelweis chain
omitted.27: standing-wave idea fights the punchline of 32
omitted.29: stage meta-joke competes with the briefing frame
omitted.31: stress card cut for length; 32 carries the landing

orderReason: Brain card 6 moved to the turn (the spokesman reads his own file); Night Shift 28 closes the department reports; security block ordered DNA -> Cancer -> Inflammation -> Autoimmune so the spin collapses step by step.

songLineChanges.songLine: The decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.

Eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain.

cues.cue: camera shutters, one flash per bar
band drops to bass and kick only

beats: Good morning. Sit down, please. I'll take your questions at the end. I already know what they are.
I speak for the Biological Metropolis. Top floor, corner office, the wrinkly one with the view.

beats.text: The City Inside has been running the civilization while you were busy with other things.
The Citizen: you never once told this city what to do. It never once asked your permission.

beats: Department reports. I read them out loud, because reading out loud is my department.

beats.text: The Heart: the brain can modify the rate. The brain cannot generate it. The badger drums alone.

beats: So I modify. Modifying is a career.

beats.text: The Lungs: seventy square meters folded into your chest, the only manual override.
The Liver: Prometheus was anatomically correct. It's the only organ that grows back.
The Gut: eighty percent of the phone calls go up to the brain. The subway runs the city.
The Night Shift: sleep is the janitorial shift washing the thoughts out of the carpet.

beats: Security briefing. No cameras for this part.

beats.text: The Immune System: a library of every murder attempt. It remembers things you have forgotten.
DNA Replication: one error per billion letters; you have had cancer, the spider usually eats it.
Cancer: evolution occurring inside you. It is not a disease; it is a competitor.
Inflammation: the response that heals the wound becomes the mechanism that burns the city.
Autoimmune: the discrimination fails, not the weapon. The gun works fine, pointed the wrong way.

beats: Off the record, between us professionals.

beats.text: The Blind Eye: you have a hole in your vision. The brain fills it in with best guesses.

beats: Historical corrections. We do issue those. Eventually.

beats.text: Andreas Vesalius looked at the body instead of the book. Everyone else was wrong.
Ignaz Semmelweis saved the mothers. The doctors committed him. He died of the infection.

beats.pre: Our official position has not changed.
beats.text: The Semmelweis Problem: evidence available, implication uncomfortable, we reject the finding.
The Humoralist: wrong in the facts, right in the vibe. It was the first Kayfabe.

beats: One more item. Somebody leaked a memo. It's about me.

beats.text: The Brain: the decision was already underway five hundred milliseconds before you made it.
You are the press secretary, not the president.

beats: And I just read it to you myself. Of course I did.

beats.text: The Scorekeeper: the body keeps the score because the body is the score.

beats: Questions? No? Good. I answered them half a second before you asked. The badger never stopped drumming. This briefing is over.
Next time a man at a podium tells you he runs the place, ask him to make his own heart beat.
